Littler won the first set, but was far from his best as Woodhouse spurned several chances at double to have taken the opener into a deciding leg. The Foxes were relegated from Division One of the County Championship last week following an innings defeat by champions Warwickshire. Leicestershire's groundsman Callum Lewin had argued filming of an unscheduled Bollywood film - believed to be for a biopic of former India captain Sourav Ganguly - had taken place at the ground four days before the Glamorgan fixture between August 20-23, preventing the pitch from being covered for eight hours in bright sunshine and heatwave temperatures. metadata.summary: The United States maintained their Presidents Cup winning streak over the International Team, with the latest victory reigniting debate about whether change is needed in the biennial contest.
metadata.content: Presidents Cup: Does Team USA's comeback win over Internationals show change is needed to make event more competitive? | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Presidents Cup: Does Team USA's comeback win over Internationals show change is needed to make event more competitive? A different format? Fewer points on offer? LIV Golf players involved? Extra team events on the schedule? We look at possible ways to make the Presidents Cup even more competitive, following the United States' record-extending 11th consecutive win over the International Team Ali Stafford Senior Sports Journalist Monday 28 September 2026 12:33, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the final day of the Presidents Cup, where Team USA dominated the Sunday singles to close out a comeback victory over the International Team The United States maintained their Presidents Cup winning streak over the International Team, with the latest victory reigniting debate about whether change is needed in the biennial contest. Brandt Snedeker's side produced the largest final-day comeback in Presidents Cup history at Medinah, winning 9.5 of the 12 points on offer in the Sunday singles to close out a record-extending 11th consecutive victory. A 17-13 winning margin doesn't tell the full picture from a closer-than-expected contest, including a foursomes session sweep for the Internationals on Friday and them leading going into the final day for just the fourth time ever. Manchester City chief executive Ferran Soriano has told a meeting of fellow club chiefs their fight against the Premier League could take years to conclude, Sky News understands. Soriano declined to answer questions from Sky News about the case as he left a private meeting of the executive board of the European Football Clubs' body in Copenhagen.
